concerns.location: tasks.md:T103 / 'Reviewer correction' preamble vs spec.md:FR-002, US-1 scenario 2
concerns.text: T103 computes descriptors 'from the pre-insertion cluster geometry', but spec FR-002 mandates descriptors 'specifically within the interface region of the GB supercell' and plan.md Phase 3 / data-model.md say 'after EAM relaxation, only within the interface mask'. The spec and plan were never amended; the task silently redefines FR-002, and the dataset.schema.yaml descriptions of cluster_size/voronoi_count ('within the interface region') now certify stale semantics. Amend spec/plan/contract or revert T103.

T105 makes the DATA_UNAVAILABLE path 'exit successfully', but FR-011 mandates MAE ≤ 0.1 eV vs a ≥30-sample DFT benchmark and SC-006 makes that a measurable outcome. The spec was never narrowed to allow the unavailable-benchmark escape; as written the task can satisfy its tag while SC-006 is unmeasurable. Amend FR-011/SC-006 to codify the conditional-validation semantics.

FR-001 requires downloading from BOTH Materials Project and OQMD via wget/curl; T102 uses only the OQMD datasets loader. The deviation is documented in plan.md but the spec FR-001 was never amended, so the task's [FR-001] tag claims satisfaction of a requirement it does not meet. Narrow FR-001 in the spec (the plan's justification is sound; the spec text is the blocker).

FR-003 requires energies 'extracted from published atomistic simulation records' and the spec Assumptions state 'no new GB supercell simulations are required'; T104 generates energies in-house with EAM. Plan documents the deviation but the spec still asserts the opposite. Amend FR-003 (and the contradictory Assumption) so the task's [FR-003] tag is truthful.

US-2 scenario 2 requires 95% confidence intervals 'for each prediction'. T108 produces intervals only via OLS get_prediction() and otherwise sets ci95_available=false; if the FR-010 verdict selects RandomForest, no per-prediction intervals exist and the acceptance criterion is silently dropped. Either amend the spec to condition CIs on the linear model or add a task producing intervals for the selected model.

FR-012 scopes VIF to 'the original three descriptors', but T107 computes VIF on 'the raw descriptors' of a 7-predictor dataset (per FR-008's predictor count = 7). Ambiguous feature set — state explicitly whether VIF covers 3 or 7 predictors and align FR-012.

US-1 scenario 1 requires download completion 'within 30 minutes of wall-clock time'; no task records or verifies download wall-clock (T111 checks only the ≤6 h total budget). Add the timing check to T102 or T111.
